facts.guard: pre-application work is not acceptance or consent

facts.decision: whether DCO application is accepted for examination

facts.guard: project page stage is not outcome
recommendation and Secretary of State decision are distinct
obsolete pre-application requirements must not be applied after the change

scope_guards: NSIP status depends on the infrastructure category, thresholds and applicable Planning Act provisions.
Pre-application preparation and advice do not constitute acceptance, examination or development consent.
The 24 July 2026 process amendments and 27 July advice updates must be applied to current cases.
Acceptance for examination tests application quality and statutory requirements but is not a DCO grant.
Pre-examination registration, examination evidence and the Examining Authority recommendation remain distinct stages.
The relevant Secretary of State grants or refuses the Development Consent Order.
A project listing, consultation response, acceptance or recommendation is not title, construction commencement or delivery evidence.
No score or promotion is written without exact project, threshold, application documents, stage, recommendation, decision and land evidence.
